notes: Poncho (old k63) rebuilt: traditional forms (ruana, sarape de Saltillo, jorongo/gabán, chamanto, poncho chilote, poncho salteño, quechquemitl, Otavalo alpaca) are archetypes with traditions; rain, army, cycling and cape ponchos are types. EcuaFina trimmed from 9 models to 2 (Elena, Maria) as versions; Ecualama Apangora dropped (not found on retrieved page), Shakai kept. 'Otava poncho' (Joutsen Finland) dropped: a modern Finnish fashion poncho, not traditional dress and not attested this session. Carla Fernández models kept in m. Five new kinds added (Huipil, Charro suit, Guayabera, Bombachas & gaucho dress, Pollera) with retrieved sources. Cubavera not added: its about page was not accessible and no Wikidata entity found. Charro-suit makers: no maker pages retrieved, so no mk; grades follow the 1960 National Charro Federation ranking. Alpargatas noted as a type pointer to Footwear only. Guatemalan huipil archetype has no versions (town styles not confirmed from retrieved pages).
